+#ifndef NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+#define NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE 32
+#endif
+constexpr int CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE = NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
+
+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const cudaError_t error, const char* expression,
+                              const char* file, const int line) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d while executing %s: %s\n",
+                 file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression)                                                   \
+    do {                                                                         \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (expression);                        \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                    \
+            cudaFailure(cuda_check_error, #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__);       \
+        }                                                                         \
+    } while (false)
+
+// A warp advances 32 bodies and reads each source position uniformly. CUDA's
+// read-only cache/coalescer services that warp-wide broadcast once, avoiding
+// both redundant global transactions and block-wide synchronization. Positions
+// are double-buffered so velocity update and integration can safely stay fused.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE)
+void simulationStepKernel(const double4* __restrict__ positions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ velocities,
+                          const int numBodies) {
+    const int bodyIndex = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+                        + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+
+    double px = 0.0;
+    double py = 0.0;
+    double pz = 0.0;
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        const double4 position = positions[bodyIndex];
+        px = position.x;
+        py = position.y;
+        pz = position.z;
+    }
+
+    double forceX = 0.0;
+    double forceY = 0.0;
+    double forceZ = 0.0;
+
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+#pragma unroll 8
+        for (int j = 0; j < numBodies; ++j) {
+            const double4 source = positions[j];
+            const double dx = source.x - px;
+            const double dy = source.y - py;
+            const double dz = source.z - pz;
+            const double distanceSquared =
+                dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+            const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+            const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance
+                                               * inverseDistance
+                                               * inverseDistance;
+
+            forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+        }
+    }
+
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        double4 velocity = velocities[bodyIndex];
+        velocity.x += DT * forceX;
+        velocity.y += DT * forceY;
+        velocity.z += DT * forceZ;
+        velocities[bodyIndex] = velocity;
+        nextPositions[bodyIndex] = make_double4(
+            px + velocity.x * DT,
+            py + velocity.y * DT,
+            pz + velocity.z * DT,
+            0.0);
+    }
+}

+#ifndef NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE

+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const cudaError_t error, const char* expression,
+                              const char* file, const int line) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d while executing %s: %s\n",
+                 file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression)                                                   \
+    do {                                                                         \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (expression);                        \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                    \
+            cudaFailure(cuda_check_error, #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__);       \
+        }                                                                         \
+    } while (false)

+// A warp advances 32 bodies and reads each source position uniformly. CUDA's
+// read-only cache/coalescer services that warp-wide broadcast once, avoiding
+// both redundant global transactions and block-wide synchronization. Positions
+// are double-buffered so velocity update and integration can safely stay fused.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE)
+void simulationStepKernel(const double4* __restrict__ positions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ velocities,
+                          const int numBodies) {
+    const int bodyIndex = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+                        + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+
+    double px = 0.0;
+    double py = 0.0;
+    double pz = 0.0;
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        const double4 position = positions[bodyIndex];
+        px = position.x;
+        py = position.y;
+        pz = position.z;
+    }
+
+    double forceX = 0.0;
+    double forceY = 0.0;
+    double forceZ = 0.0;
+
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+#pragma unroll 8
+        for (int j = 0; j < numBodies; ++j) {
+            const double4 source = positions[j];
+            const double dx = source.x - px;
+            const double dy = source.y - py;
+            const double dz = source.z - pz;
+            const double distanceSquared =
+                dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+            const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+            const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance
+                                               * inverseDistance
+                                               * inverseDistance;
+
+            forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+        }
+    }
+
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        double4 velocity = velocities[bodyIndex];
+        velocity.x += DT * forceX;
+        velocity.y += DT * forceY;
+        velocity.z += DT * forceZ;
+        velocities[bodyIndex] = velocity;
+        nextPositions[bodyIndex] = make_double4(
+            px + velocity.x * DT,
+            py + velocity.y * DT,
+            pz + velocity.z * DT,
+            0.0);
+    }
+}

+#ifndef NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+#define NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE 32
+#endif
+constexpr int CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE = NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
+
+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const cudaError_t error, const char* expression,
+                              const char* file, const int line) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d while executing %s: %s\n",
+                 file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression)                                                   \
+    do {                                                                         \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (expression);                        \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                    \
+            cudaFailure(cuda_check_error, #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__);       \
+        }                                                                         \
+    } while (false)
+
+// A warp advances 32 bodies and reads each source position uniformly. CUDA's
+// read-only cache/coalescer services that warp-wide broadcast once, avoiding
+// both redundant global transactions and block-wide synchronization. Positions
+// are double-buffered so velocity update and integration can safely stay fused.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE)
+void simulationStepKernel(const double4* __restrict__ positions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ velocities,
+                          const int numBodies) {
+    const int bodyIndex = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+                        + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+
+    double px = 0.0;
+    double py = 0.0;
+    double pz = 0.0;
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        const double4 position = positions[bodyIndex];
+        px = position.x;
+        py = position.y;
+        pz = position.z;
+    }
+
+    double forceX = 0.0;
+    double forceY = 0.0;
+    double forceZ = 0.0;
+
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+#pragma unroll 8
+        for (int j = 0; j < numBodies; ++j) {
+            const double4 source = positions[j];
+            const double dx = source.x - px;
+            const double dy = source.y - py;
+            const double dz = source.z - pz;
+            const double distanceSquared =
+                dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+            const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+            const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance
+                                               * inverseDistance
+                                               * inverseDistance;
+
+            forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+        }
+    }
+
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        double4 velocity = velocities[bodyIndex];
+        velocity.x += DT * forceX;
+        velocity.y += DT * forceY;
+        velocity.z += DT * forceZ;
+        velocities[bodyIndex] = velocity;
+        nextPositions[bodyIndex] = make_double4(
+            px + velocity.x * DT,
+            py + velocity.y * DT,
+            pz + velocity.z * DT,
+            0.0);
+    }
+}

+#ifndef NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+#define NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE 32
+#endif
+constexpr int CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE = NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
+
+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const cudaError_t error, const char* expression,
+                              const char* file, const int line) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d while executing %s: %s\n",
+                 file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression)                                                   \
+    do {                                                                         \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (expression);                        \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                    \
+            cudaFailure(cuda_check_error, #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__);       \
+        }                                                                         \
+    } while (false)
+
+// A warp advances 32 bodies and cooperatively stages 32 source positions at a
+// time. Warp synchronization is sufficient for the one-warp block, minimizing
+// barriers while retaining broadcast-friendly shared-memory reads. Positions
+// are double-buffered so velocity update and integration can safely stay fused.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE)
+void simulationStepKernel(const double4* __restrict__ positions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ velocities,
+                          const int numBodies) {
+    __shared__ double4 positionTile[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+
+    const int bodyIndex = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+                        + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+
+    double px = 0.0;
+    double py = 0.0;
+    double pz = 0.0;
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        const double4 position = positions[bodyIndex];
+        px = position.x;
+        py = position.y;
+        pz = position.z;
+    }
+
+    double forceX = 0.0;
+    double forceY = 0.0;
+    double forceZ = 0.0;
+
+    for (int tileStart = 0; tileStart < numBodies;
+         tileStart += CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) {
+        const int sourceIndex = tileStart + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (sourceIndex < numBodies) {
+            positionTile[threadIdx.x] = positions[sourceIndex];
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+
+        const int tileSize = min(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, numBodies - tileStart);
+        if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+#pragma unroll 8
+            for (int j = 0; j < tileSize; ++j) {
+                const double4 source = positionTile[j];
+                const double dx = source.x - px;
+                const double dy = source.y - py;
+                const double dz = source.z - pz;
+                const double distanceSquared =
+                    dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+                const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance;
+
+                forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+    }
+
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        double4 velocity = velocities[bodyIndex];
+        velocity.x += DT * forceX;
+        velocity.y += DT * forceY;
+        velocity.z += DT * forceZ;
+        velocities[bodyIndex] = velocity;
+        nextPositions[bodyIndex] = make_double4(
+            px + velocity.x * DT,
+            py + velocity.y * DT,
+            pz + velocity.z * DT,
+            0.0);
+    }
+}

+#ifndef NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+#define NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE 32
+#endif
+constexpr int CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE = NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
+
+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const cudaError_t error, const char* expression,
+                              const char* file, const int line) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d while executing %s: %s\n",
+                 file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression)                                                   \
+    do {                                                                         \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (expression);                        \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                    \
+            cudaFailure(cuda_check_error, #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__);       \
+        }                                                                         \
+    } while (false)
+
+// A warp advances 32 bodies and cooperatively stages 32 source positions at a
+// time. Warp synchronization is sufficient for the one-warp block, minimizing
+// barriers while retaining broadcast-friendly shared-memory reads. Positions
+// are double-buffered so velocity update and integration can safely stay fused.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE)
+void simulationStepKernel(const double4* __restrict__ positions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ velocities,
+                          const int numBodies) {
+    __shared__ double4 positionTile[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+
+    const int bodyIndex = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+                        + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+
+    double px = 0.0;
+    double py = 0.0;
+    double pz = 0.0;
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        const double4 position = positions[bodyIndex];
+        px = position.x;
+        py = position.y;
+        pz = position.z;
+    }
+
+    double forceX = 0.0;
+    double forceY = 0.0;
+    double forceZ = 0.0;
+
+    for (int tileStart = 0; tileStart < numBodies;
+         tileStart += CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) {
+        const int sourceIndex = tileStart + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (sourceIndex < numBodies) {
+            positionTile[threadIdx.x] = positions[sourceIndex];
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+
+        const int tileSize = min(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, numBodies - tileStart);
+        if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+#pragma unroll 8
+            for (int j = 0; j < tileSize; ++j) {
+                const double4 source = positionTile[j];
+                const double dx = source.x - px;
+                const double dy = source.y - py;
+                const double dz = source.z - pz;
+                const double distanceSquared =
+                    dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+                const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance;
+
+                forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+    }
+
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        double4 velocity = velocities[bodyIndex];
+        velocity.x += DT * forceX;
+        velocity.y += DT * forceY;
+        velocity.z += DT * forceZ;
+        velocities[bodyIndex] = velocity;
+        nextPositions[bodyIndex] = make_double4(
+            px + velocity.x * DT,
+            py + velocity.y * DT,
+            pz + velocity.z * DT,
+            0.0);
+    }
+}

+#ifndef NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+#define NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE 32
+#endif
+constexpr int CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE = NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
+
+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const cudaError_t error, const char* expression,
+                              const char* file, const int line) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d while executing %s: %s\n",
+                 file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression)                                                   \
+    do {                                                                         \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (expression);                        \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                    \
+            cudaFailure(cuda_check_error, #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__);       \
+        }                                                                         \
+    } while (false)
+
+// A warp advances 32 bodies and cooperatively stages 32 source positions at a
+// time. Warp synchronization is sufficient for the one-warp block, minimizing
+// barriers while retaining broadcast-friendly shared-memory reads. Positions
+// are double-buffered so velocity update and integration can safely stay fused.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE)
+void simulationStepKernel(const double4* __restrict__ positions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ velocities,
+                          const int numBodies) {
+    __shared__ double4 positionTile[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+
+    const int bodyIndex = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+                        + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+
+    double px = 0.0;
+    double py = 0.0;
+    double pz = 0.0;
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        const double4 position = positions[bodyIndex];
+        px = position.x;
+        py = position.y;
+        pz = position.z;
+    }
+
+    double forceX = 0.0;
+    double forceY = 0.0;
+    double forceZ = 0.0;
+
+    for (int tileStart = 0; tileStart < numBodies;
+         tileStart += CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) {
+        const int sourceIndex = tileStart + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (sourceIndex < numBodies) {
+            positionTile[threadIdx.x] = positions[sourceIndex];
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+
+        const int tileSize = min(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, numBodies - tileStart);
+        if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+#pragma unroll 8
+            for (int j = 0; j < tileSize; ++j) {
+                const double4 source = positionTile[j];
+                const double dx = source.x - px;
+                const double dy = source.y - py;
+                const double dz = source.z - pz;
+                const double distanceSquared =
+                    dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+                const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance;
+
+                forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+    }
+
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        double4 velocity = velocities[bodyIndex];
+        velocity.x += DT * forceX;
+        velocity.y += DT * forceY;
+        velocity.z += DT * forceZ;
+        velocities[bodyIndex] = velocity;
+        nextPositions[bodyIndex] = make_double4(
+            px + velocity.x * DT,
+            py + velocity.y * DT,
+            pz + velocity.z * DT,
+            0.0);
+    }
+}

+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const cudaError_t error, const char* expression,
+                              const char* file, const int line) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d while executing %s: %s\n",
+                 file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression)                                                   \
+    do {                                                                         \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (expression);                        \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                    \
+            cudaFailure(cuda_check_error, #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__);       \
+        }                                                                         \
+    } while (false)

+// A warp advances 32 bodies and cooperatively stages 32 source positions at a
+// time. Warp synchronization is sufficient for the one-warp block, minimizing
+// barriers while retaining broadcast-friendly shared-memory reads. Positions
+// are double-buffered so velocity update and integration can safely stay fused.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE)
+void simulationStepKernel(const double4* __restrict__ positions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ velocities,
+                          const int numBodies) {
+    __shared__ double4 positionTile[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+
+    const int bodyIndex = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+                        + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+
+    double px = 0.0;
+    double py = 0.0;
+    double pz = 0.0;
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        const double4 position = positions[bodyIndex];
+        px = position.x;
+        py = position.y;
+        pz = position.z;
+    }
+
+    double forceX = 0.0;
+    double forceY = 0.0;
+    double forceZ = 0.0;
+
+    for (int tileStart = 0; tileStart < numBodies;
+         tileStart += CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) {
+        const int sourceIndex = tileStart + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (sourceIndex < numBodies) {
+            positionTile[threadIdx.x] = positions[sourceIndex];
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+
+        const int tileSize = min(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, numBodies - tileStart);
+        if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+#pragma unroll 8
+            for (int j = 0; j < tileSize; ++j) {
+                const double4 source = positionTile[j];
+                const double dx = source.x - px;
+                const double dy = source.y - py;
+                const double dz = source.z - pz;
+                const double distanceSquared =
+                    dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+#ifdef NBODY_USE_RSQRT
+                const double inverseDistance = rsqrt(distanceSquared);
+#else
+                const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+#endif
+                const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance;
+
+                forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+    }
+
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        double4 velocity = velocities[bodyIndex];
+        velocity.x += DT * forceX;
+        velocity.y += DT * forceY;
+        velocity.z += DT * forceZ;
+        velocities[bodyIndex] = velocity;
+        nextPositions[bodyIndex] = make_double4(
+            px + velocity.x * DT,
+            py + velocity.y * DT,
+            pz + velocity.z * DT,
+            0.0);
+    }

+// barriers while retaining broadcast-friendly shared-memory reads. Positions
+// are double-buffered so velocity update and integration can safely stay fused.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE)
+void simulationStepKernel(const double4* __restrict__ positions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ velocities,
+                          const int numBodies) {
+    __shared__ double4 positionTile[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+
+    const int bodyIndex = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+                        + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+
+    double px = 0.0;
+    double py = 0.0;
+    double pz = 0.0;
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        const double4 position = positions[bodyIndex];
+        px = position.x;
+        py = position.y;
+        pz = position.z;
+    }
+
+    double forceX = 0.0;
+    double forceY = 0.0;
+    double forceZ = 0.0;
+
+    for (int tileStart = 0; tileStart < numBodies;
+         tileStart += CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) {
+        const int sourceIndex = tileStart + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (sourceIndex < numBodies) {
+            positionTile[threadIdx.x] = positions[sourceIndex];
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+
+        const int tileSize = min(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, numBodies - tileStart);
+        if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+#pragma unroll 8
+            for (int j = 0; j < tileSize; ++j) {
+                const double4 source = positionTile[j];
+                const double dx = source.x - px;
+                const double dy = source.y - py;
+                const double dz = source.z - pz;
+                const double distanceSquared =
+                    dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+#ifdef NBODY_USE_RSQRT
+                const double inverseDistance = rsqrt(distanceSquared);
+#else
+                const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+#endif
+                const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance;
+
+                forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+    }
+
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        double4 velocity = velocities[bodyIndex];
+        velocity.x += DT * forceX;
+        velocity.y += DT * forceY;
+        velocity.z += DT * forceZ;
+        velocities[bodyIndex] = velocity;
+        nextPositions[bodyIndex] = make_double4(
+            px + velocity.x * DT,
+            py + velocity.y * DT,
+            pz + velocity.z * DT,
+            0.0);
+    }
+}

+#ifndef NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+#define NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE 32
+#endif
+constexpr int CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE = NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
+
+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const cudaError_t error, const char* expression,
+                              const char* file, const int line) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d while executing %s: %s\n",
+                 file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression)                                                   \
+    do {                                                                         \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (expression);                        \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                    \
+            cudaFailure(cuda_check_error, #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__);       \
+        }                                                                         \
+    } while (false)

+// A warp advances 32 bodies and cooperatively stages 32 source positions at a
+// time. Warp synchronization is sufficient for the one-warp block, minimizing
+// barriers while retaining broadcast-friendly shared-memory reads. Positions
+// are double-buffered so velocity update and integration can safely stay fused.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE)
+void simulationStepKernel(const double4* __restrict__ positions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ velocities,
+                          const int numBodies) {
+    __shared__ double4 positionTile[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+
+    const int bodyIndex = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+                        + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+
+    double px = 0.0;
+    double py = 0.0;
+    double pz = 0.0;
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        const double4 position = positions[bodyIndex];
+        px = position.x;
+        py = position.y;
+        pz = position.z;
+    }
+
+    double forceX = 0.0;
+    double forceY = 0.0;
+    double forceZ = 0.0;
+
+    for (int tileStart = 0; tileStart < numBodies;
+         tileStart += CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) {
+        const int sourceIndex = tileStart + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (sourceIndex < numBodies) {
+            positionTile[threadIdx.x] = positions[sourceIndex];
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+
+        const int tileSize = min(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, numBodies - tileStart);
+        if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+#pragma unroll 8
+            for (int j = 0; j < tileSize; ++j) {
+                const double4 source = positionTile[j];
+                const double dx = source.x - px;
+                const double dy = source.y - py;
+                const double dz = source.z - pz;
+                const double distanceSquared =
+                    dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+#ifdef NBODY_USE_RSQRT
+                const double inverseDistance = rsqrt(distanceSquared);
+#else
+                const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+#endif
+                const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance;
+
+                forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+    }
+
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        double4 velocity = velocities[bodyIndex];
+        velocity.x += DT * forceX;
+        velocity.y += DT * forceY;
+        velocity.z += DT * forceZ;
+        velocities[bodyIndex] = velocity;
+        nextPositions[bodyIndex] = make_double4(
+            px + velocity.x * DT,
+            py + velocity.y * DT,
+            pz + velocity.z * DT,
+            0.0);
+    }
+}

+#ifndef NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+#define NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE 32
+#endif
+constexpr int CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE = NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
+
+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const cudaError_t error, const char* expression,
+                              const char* file, const int line) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d while executing %s: %s\n",
+                 file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression)                                                   \
+    do {                                                                         \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (expression);                        \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                    \
+            cudaFailure(cuda_check_error, #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__);       \
+        }                                                                         \
+    } while (false)
+
+// A warp advances 32 bodies and cooperatively stages 32 source positions at a
+// time. Warp synchronization is sufficient for the one-warp block, minimizing
+// barriers while retaining broadcast-friendly shared-memory reads. Positions
+// are double-buffered so velocity update and integration can safely stay fused.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE)
+void simulationStepKernel(const double4* __restrict__ positions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ velocities,
+                          const int numBodies) {
+    __shared__ double4 positionTile[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+
+    const int bodyIndex = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+                        + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+
+    double px = 0.0;
+    double py = 0.0;
+    double pz = 0.0;
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        const double4 position = positions[bodyIndex];
+        px = position.x;
+        py = position.y;
+        pz = position.z;
+    }
+
+    double forceX = 0.0;
+    double forceY = 0.0;
+    double forceZ = 0.0;
+
+    for (int tileStart = 0; tileStart < numBodies;
+         tileStart += CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) {
+        const int sourceIndex = tileStart + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (sourceIndex < numBodies) {
+            positionTile[threadIdx.x] = positions[sourceIndex];
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+
+        const int tileSize = min(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, numBodies - tileStart);
+        if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+#pragma unroll 8
+            for (int j = 0; j < tileSize; ++j) {
+                const double4 source = positionTile[j];
+                const double dx = source.x - px;
+                const double dy = source.y - py;
+                const double dz = source.z - pz;
+                const double distanceSquared =
+                    dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+#ifdef NBODY_USE_RSQRT
+                const double inverseDistance = rsqrt(distanceSquared);
+#else
+                const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+#endif
+                const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance;
+
+                forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+    }
+
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        double4 velocity = velocities[bodyIndex];
+        velocity.x += DT * forceX;
+        velocity.y += DT * forceY;
+        velocity.z += DT * forceZ;
+        velocities[bodyIndex] = velocity;
+        nextPositions[bodyIndex] = make_double4(
+            px + velocity.x * DT,
+            py + velocity.y * DT,
+            pz + velocity.z * DT,
+            0.0);
+    }
+}

+#ifndef NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+#define NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE 32
+#endif
+constexpr int CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE = NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
+#ifndef NBODY_CUDA_UNROLL
+#define NBODY_CUDA_UNROLL 8
+#endif
+
+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const cudaError_t error, const char* expression,
+                              const char* file, const int line) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d while executing %s: %s\n",
+                 file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression)                                                   \
+    do {                                                                         \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (expression);                        \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                    \
+            cudaFailure(cuda_check_error, #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__);       \
+        }                                                                         \
+    } while (false)
+
+// A warp advances 32 bodies and cooperatively stages 32 source positions at a
+// time. Warp synchronization is sufficient for the one-warp block, minimizing
+// barriers while retaining broadcast-friendly shared-memory reads. Positions
+// are double-buffered so velocity update and integration can safely stay fused.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE)
+void simulationStepKernel(const double4* __restrict__ positions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ velocities,
+                          const int numBodies) {
+    __shared__ double4 positionTile[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+
+    const int bodyIndex = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+                        + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+
+    double px = 0.0;
+    double py = 0.0;
+    double pz = 0.0;
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        const double4 position = positions[bodyIndex];
+        px = position.x;
+        py = position.y;
+        pz = position.z;
+    }
+
+    double forceX = 0.0;
+    double forceY = 0.0;
+    double forceZ = 0.0;
+
+    for (int tileStart = 0; tileStart < numBodies;
+         tileStart += CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) {
+        const int sourceIndex = tileStart + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (sourceIndex < numBodies) {
+            positionTile[threadIdx.x] = positions[sourceIndex];
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+
+        const int tileSize = min(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, numBodies - tileStart);
+        if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+#pragma unroll NBODY_CUDA_UNROLL
+            for (int j = 0; j < tileSize; ++j) {
+                const double4 source = positionTile[j];
+                const double dx = source.x - px;
+                const double dy = source.y - py;
+                const double dz = source.z - pz;
+                const double distanceSquared =
+                    dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+#ifdef NBODY_USE_RSQRT
+                const double inverseDistance = rsqrt(distanceSquared);
+#else
+                const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+#endif
+                const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance;
+
+                forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+    }
+
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        double4 velocity = velocities[bodyIndex];
+        velocity.x += DT * forceX;
+        velocity.y += DT * forceY;
+        velocity.z += DT * forceZ;
+        velocities[bodyIndex] = velocity;
+        nextPositions[bodyIndex] = make_double4(
+            px + velocity.x * DT,
+            py + velocity.y * DT,
+            pz + velocity.z * DT,
+            0.0);
+    }
+}

+// A warp advances 32 bodies and cooperatively stages 32 source positions at a
+// time. Warp synchronization is sufficient for the one-warp block, minimizing
+// barriers while retaining broadcast-friendly shared-memory reads. Positions
+// are double-buffered so velocity update and integration can safely stay fused.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE)
+void simulationStepKernel(const double4* __restrict__ positions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ velocities,
+                          const int numBodies) {
+    __shared__ double4 positionTile[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+
+    const int bodyIndex = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+                        + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+
+    double px = 0.0;
+    double py = 0.0;
+    double pz = 0.0;
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        const double4 position = positions[bodyIndex];
+        px = position.x;
+        py = position.y;
+        pz = position.z;
+    }
+
+    double forceX = 0.0;
+    double forceY = 0.0;
+    double forceZ = 0.0;
+
+    for (int tileStart = 0; tileStart < numBodies;
+         tileStart += CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) {
+        const int sourceIndex = tileStart + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (sourceIndex < numBodies) {
+            positionTile[threadIdx.x] = positions[sourceIndex];
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+
+        const int tileSize = min(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, numBodies - tileStart);
+        if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+#pragma unroll NBODY_CUDA_UNROLL
+            for (int j = 0; j < tileSize; ++j) {
+                const double4 source = positionTile[j];
+                const double dx = source.x - px;
+                const double dy = source.y - py;
+                const double dz = source.z - pz;
+                const double distanceSquared =
+                    dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+#ifdef NBODY_USE_RSQRT
+                const double inverseDistance = rsqrt(distanceSquared);
+#else
+                const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+#endif
+                const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance;
+
+                forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+    }
+
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        double4 velocity = velocities[bodyIndex];
+        velocity.x += DT * forceX;
+        velocity.y += DT * forceY;
+        velocity.z += DT * forceZ;
+        velocities[bodyIndex] = velocity;
+        nextPositions[bodyIndex] = make_double4(
+            px + velocity.x * DT,
+            py + velocity.y * DT,
+            pz + velocity.z * DT,
+            0.0);
+    }
+}

+// A warp advances 32 bodies and cooperatively stages 32 source positions at a
+// time. Warp synchronization is sufficient for the one-warp block, minimizing
+// barriers while retaining broadcast-friendly shared-memory reads. Positions
+// are double-buffered so velocity update and integration can safely stay fused.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE)
+void simulationStepKernel(const double4* __restrict__ positions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ velocities,
+                          const int numBodies) {
+    __shared__ double4 positionTile[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+
+    const int bodyIndex = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+                        + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+
+    double px = 0.0;
+    double py = 0.0;
+    double pz = 0.0;
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        const double4 position = positions[bodyIndex];
+        px = position.x;
+        py = position.y;
+        pz = position.z;
+    }
+
+    double forceX = 0.0;
+    double forceY = 0.0;
+    double forceZ = 0.0;
+
+    for (int tileStart = 0; tileStart < numBodies;
+         tileStart += CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) {
+        const int sourceIndex = tileStart + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (sourceIndex < numBodies) {
+            positionTile[threadIdx.x] = positions[sourceIndex];
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+
+        const int tileSize = min(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, numBodies - tileStart);
+        if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+#pragma unroll NBODY_CUDA_UNROLL
+            for (int j = 0; j < tileSize; ++j) {
+                const double4 source = positionTile[j];
+                const double dx = source.x - px;
+                const double dy = source.y - py;
+                const double dz = source.z - pz;
+                const double distanceSquared =
+                    dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+#ifdef NBODY_USE_RSQRT
+                const double inverseDistance = rsqrt(distanceSquared);
+#else
+                const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+#endif
+                const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance;
+
+                forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+    }
+
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        double4 velocity = velocities[bodyIndex];
+        velocity.x += DT * forceX;
+        velocity.y += DT * forceY;
+        velocity.z += DT * forceZ;
+        velocities[bodyIndex] = velocity;
+        nextPositions[bodyIndex] = make_double4(
+            px + velocity.x * DT,
+            py + velocity.y * DT,
+            pz + velocity.z * DT,
+            0.0);
+    }
+}

+#ifndef NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+#define NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE 32
+#endif

+#define NBODY_CUDA_UNROLL 8

+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const cudaError_t error, const char* expression,
+                              const char* file, const int line) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d while executing %s: %s\n",
+                 file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression)                                                   \
+    do {                                                                         \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (expression);                        \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                    \
+            cudaFailure(cuda_check_error, #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__);       \
+        }                                                                         \
+    } while (false)

+// A warp advances 32 bodies and cooperatively stages 32 source positions at a
+// time. Warp synchronization is sufficient for the one-warp block, minimizing
+// barriers while retaining broadcast-friendly shared-memory reads. Positions
+// are double-buffered so velocity update and integration can safely stay fused.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE)
+void simulationStepKernel(const double4* __restrict__ positions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ velocities,
+                          const int numBodies) {
+    __shared__ double4 positionTile[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+
+    const int bodyIndex = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+                        + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+
+    double px = 0.0;
+    double py = 0.0;
+    double pz = 0.0;
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        const double4 position = positions[bodyIndex];
+        px = position.x;
+        py = position.y;
+        pz = position.z;
+    }
+
+    double forceX = 0.0;
+    double forceY = 0.0;
+    double forceZ = 0.0;
+
+    for (int tileStart = 0; tileStart < numBodies;
+         tileStart += CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) {
+        const int sourceIndex = tileStart + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (sourceIndex < numBodies) {
+            positionTile[threadIdx.x] = positions[sourceIndex];
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+
+        const int tileSize = min(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, numBodies - tileStart);
+        if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+#pragma unroll CUDA_UNROLL
+            for (int j = 0; j < tileSize; ++j) {
+                const double4 source = positionTile[j];
+                const double dx = source.x - px;
+                const double dy = source.y - py;
+                const double dz = source.z - pz;
+                const double distanceSquared =
+                    dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+#ifdef NBODY_USE_RSQRT
+                const double inverseDistance = rsqrt(distanceSquared);
+#else
+                const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+#endif
+                const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance;
+
+                forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+    }
+
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        double4 velocity = velocities[bodyIndex];
+        velocity.x += DT * forceX;
+        velocity.y += DT * forceY;
+        velocity.z += DT * forceZ;
+        velocities[bodyIndex] = velocity;
+        nextPositions[bodyIndex] = make_double4(
+            px + velocity.x * DT,
+            py + velocity.y * DT,
+            pz + velocity.z * DT,
+            0.0);
+    }
+}

+#ifndef NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+#define NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE 32
+#endif
+constexpr int CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE = NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
+#ifndef NBODY_CUDA_UNROLL
+#define NBODY_CUDA_UNROLL 8
+#endif
+constexpr int CUDA_UNROLL = NBODY_CUDA_UNROLL;
+
+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const cudaError_t error, const char* expression,
+                              const char* file, const int line) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d while executing %s: %s\n",
+                 file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression)                                                   \
+    do {                                                                         \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (expression);                        \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                    \
+            cudaFailure(cuda_check_error, #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__);       \
+        }                                                                         \
+    } while (false)
+
+// A warp advances 32 bodies and cooperatively stages 32 source positions at a
+// time. Warp synchronization is sufficient for the one-warp block, minimizing
+// barriers while retaining broadcast-friendly shared-memory reads. Positions
+// are double-buffered so velocity update and integration can safely stay fused.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE)
+void simulationStepKernel(const double4* __restrict__ positions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ velocities,
+                          const int numBodies) {
+    __shared__ double4 positionTile[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+
+    const int bodyIndex = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+                        + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+
+    double px = 0.0;
+    double py = 0.0;
+    double pz = 0.0;
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        const double4 position = positions[bodyIndex];
+        px = position.x;
+        py = position.y;
+        pz = position.z;
+    }
+
+    double forceX = 0.0;
+    double forceY = 0.0;
+    double forceZ = 0.0;
+
+    for (int tileStart = 0; tileStart < numBodies;
+         tileStart += CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) {
+        const int sourceIndex = tileStart + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (sourceIndex < numBodies) {
+            positionTile[threadIdx.x] = positions[sourceIndex];
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+
+        const int tileSize = min(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, numBodies - tileStart);
+        if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+#pragma unroll CUDA_UNROLL
+            for (int j = 0; j < tileSize; ++j) {
+                const double4 source = positionTile[j];
+                const double dx = source.x - px;
+                const double dy = source.y - py;
+                const double dz = source.z - pz;
+                const double distanceSquared =
+                    dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+#ifdef NBODY_USE_RSQRT
+                const double inverseDistance = rsqrt(distanceSquared);
+#else
+                const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+#endif
+                const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance;
+
+                forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+    }
+
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        double4 velocity = velocities[bodyIndex];
+        velocity.x += DT * forceX;
+        velocity.y += DT * forceY;
+        velocity.z += DT * forceZ;
+        velocities[bodyIndex] = velocity;
+        nextPositions[bodyIndex] = make_double4(
+            px + velocity.x * DT,
+            py + velocity.y * DT,
+            pz + velocity.z * DT,
+            0.0);
+    }
+}

+// time. Warp synchronization is sufficient for the one-warp block, minimizing
+// barriers while retaining broadcast-friendly shared-memory reads. Positions
+// are double-buffered so velocity update and integration can safely stay fused.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE)
+void simulationStepKernel(const double4* __restrict__ positions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ velocities,
+                          const int numBodies) {
+    __shared__ double4 positionTile[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+
+    const int bodyIndex = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+                        + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+
+    double px = 0.0;
+    double py = 0.0;
+    double pz = 0.0;
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        const double4 position = positions[bodyIndex];
+        px = position.x;
+        py = position.y;
+        pz = position.z;
+    }
+
+    double forceX = 0.0;
+    double forceY = 0.0;
+    double forceZ = 0.0;
+
+    for (int tileStart = 0; tileStart < numBodies;
+         tileStart += CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) {
+        const int sourceIndex = tileStart + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (sourceIndex < numBodies) {
+            positionTile[threadIdx.x] = positions[sourceIndex];
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+
+        const int tileSize = min(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, numBodies - tileStart);
+        if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+#pragma unroll CUDA_UNROLL
+            for (int j = 0; j < tileSize; ++j) {
+                const double4 source = positionTile[j];
+                const double dx = source.x - px;
+                const double dy = source.y - py;
+                const double dz = source.z - pz;
+                const double distanceSquared =
+                    dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+#ifdef NBODY_USE_RSQRT
+                const double inverseDistance = rsqrt(distanceSquared);
+#else
+                const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+#endif
+                const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance;
+
+                forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+    }
+
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        double4 velocity = velocities[bodyIndex];
+        velocity.x += DT * forceX;
+        velocity.y += DT * forceY;
+        velocity.z += DT * forceZ;
+        velocities[bodyIndex] = velocity;
+        nextPositions[bodyIndex] = make_double4(
+            px + velocity.x * DT,
+            py + velocity.y * DT,
+            pz + velocity.z * DT,
+            0.0);
+    }
+}

+#ifndef NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+#define NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE 32
+#endif
+constexpr int CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE = NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
+#ifndef NBODY_CUDA_UNROLL
+#define NBODY_CUDA_UNROLL 8
+#endif
+constexpr int CUDA_UNROLL = NBODY_CUDA_UNROLL;
+
+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const cudaError_t error, const char* expression,
+                              const char* file, const int line) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d while executing %s: %s\n",
+                 file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression)                                                   \
+    do {                                                                         \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (expression);                        \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                    \
+            cudaFailure(cuda_check_error, #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__);       \
+        }                                                                         \
+    } while (false)
+
+// A warp advances 32 bodies and cooperatively stages 32 source positions at a
+// time. Warp synchronization is sufficient for the one-warp block, minimizing
+// barriers while retaining broadcast-friendly shared-memory reads. Positions
+// are double-buffered so velocity update and integration can safely stay fused.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE)
+void simulationStepKernel(const double4* __restrict__ positions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ velocities,
+                          const int numBodies) {
+    __shared__ double4 positionTile[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+
+    const int bodyIndex = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+                        + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+
+    double px = 0.0;
+    double py = 0.0;
+    double pz = 0.0;
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        const double4 position = positions[bodyIndex];
+        px = position.x;
+        py = position.y;
+        pz = position.z;
+    }
+
+    double forceX = 0.0;
+    double forceY = 0.0;
+    double forceZ = 0.0;
+
+    for (int tileStart = 0; tileStart < numBodies;
+         tileStart += CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) {
+        const int sourceIndex = tileStart + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (sourceIndex < numBodies) {
+            positionTile[threadIdx.x] = positions[sourceIndex];
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+
+        const int tileSize = min(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, numBodies - tileStart);
+        if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+#pragma unroll CUDA_UNROLL
+            for (int j = 0; j < tileSize; ++j) {
+                const double4 source = positionTile[j];
+                const double dx = source.x - px;
+                const double dy = source.y - py;
+                const double dz = source.z - pz;
+                const double distanceSquared =
+                    dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+#ifdef NBODY_USE_RSQRT
+                const double inverseDistance = rsqrt(distanceSquared);
+#else
+                const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+#endif
+                const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance;
+
+                forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+    }
+
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        double4 velocity = velocities[bodyIndex];
+        velocity.x += DT * forceX;
+        velocity.y += DT * forceY;
+        velocity.z += DT * forceZ;
+        velocities[bodyIndex] = velocity;
+        nextPositions[bodyIndex] = make_double4(
+            px + velocity.x * DT,
+            py + velocity.y * DT,
+            pz + velocity.z * DT,
+            0.0);
+    }
+}

+// A warp advances 32 bodies and cooperatively stages 32 source positions at a
+// time. Warp synchronization is sufficient for the one-warp block, minimizing
+// barriers while retaining broadcast-friendly shared-memory reads. Positions
+// are double-buffered so velocity update and integration can safely stay fused.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE)
+void simulationStepKernel(const double4* __restrict__ positions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ velocities,
+                          const int numBodies) {
+    __shared__ double4 positionTile[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+
+    const int bodyIndex = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+                        + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+
+    double px = 0.0;
+    double py = 0.0;
+    double pz = 0.0;
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        const double4 position = positions[bodyIndex];
+        px = position.x;
+        py = position.y;
+        pz = position.z;
+    }
+
+    double forceX = 0.0;
+    double forceY = 0.0;
+    double forceZ = 0.0;
+
+    for (int tileStart = 0; tileStart < numBodies;
+         tileStart += CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) {
+        const int sourceIndex = tileStart + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (sourceIndex < numBodies) {
+            positionTile[threadIdx.x] = positions[sourceIndex];
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+
+        const int tileSize = min(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, numBodies - tileStart);
+        if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+#pragma unroll CUDA_UNROLL
+            for (int j = 0; j < tileSize; ++j) {
+                const double4 source = positionTile[j];
+                const double dx = source.x - px;
+                const double dy = source.y - py;
+                const double dz = source.z - pz;
+                const double distanceSquared =
+                    dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+#ifdef NBODY_USE_RSQRT
+                const double inverseDistance = rsqrt(distanceSquared);
+#else
+                const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+#endif
+                const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance;
+
+                forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+    }
+
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        double4 velocity = velocities[bodyIndex];
+        velocity.x += DT * forceX;
+        velocity.y += DT * forceY;
+        velocity.z += DT * forceZ;
+        velocities[bodyIndex] = velocity;
+        nextPositions[bodyIndex] = make_double4(
+            px + velocity.x * DT,
+            py + velocity.y * DT,
+            pz + velocity.z * DT,
+            0.0);
+    }
+}

+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const cudaError_t error, const char* expression,
+                              const char* file, const int line) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d while executing %s: %s\n",
+                 file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression)                                                   \
+    do {                                                                         \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (expression);                        \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                    \
+            cudaFailure(cuda_check_error, #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__);       \
+        }                                                                         \

+// A warp advances 32 bodies and cooperatively stages 32 source positions at a
+// time. Warp synchronization is sufficient for the one-warp block, minimizing
+// barriers while retaining broadcast-friendly shared-memory reads. Positions
+// are double-buffered so velocity update and integration can safely stay fused.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE)
+void simulationStepKernel(const double4* __restrict__ positions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ velocities,
+                          const int numBodies) {
+    __shared__ double4 positionTile[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+
+    const int bodyIndex = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+                        + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+
+    double px = 0.0;
+    double py = 0.0;
+    double pz = 0.0;
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        const double4 position = positions[bodyIndex];
+        px = position.x;
+        py = position.y;
+        pz = position.z;
+    }
+
+    double forceX = 0.0;
+    double forceY = 0.0;
+    double forceZ = 0.0;
+
+    for (int tileStart = 0; tileStart < numBodies;
+         tileStart += CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) {
+        const int sourceIndex = tileStart + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (sourceIndex < numBodies) {
+            positionTile[threadIdx.x] = positions[sourceIndex];
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+
+        const int tileSize = min(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, numBodies - tileStart);
+        if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+#pragma unroll CUDA_UNROLL
+            for (int j = 0; j < tileSize; ++j) {
+                const double4 source = positionTile[j];
+                const double dx = source.x - px;
+                const double dy = source.y - py;
+                const double dz = source.z - pz;
+                const double distanceSquared =
+                    dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+#ifdef NBODY_USE_RSQRT
+                const double inverseDistance = rsqrt(distanceSquared);
+#else
+                const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+#endif
+                const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance;
+
+                forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+    }
+
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        double4 velocity = velocities[bodyIndex];
+        velocity.x += DT * forceX;
+        velocity.y += DT * forceY;
+        velocity.z += DT * forceZ;
+        velocities[bodyIndex] = velocity;
+        nextPositions[bodyIndex] = make_double4(
+            px + velocity.x * DT,
+            py + velocity.y * DT,
+            pz + velocity.z * DT,
+            0.0);
+    }
+}

+#ifndef NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+#define NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE 32
+#endif
+constexpr int CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE = NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
+#ifndef NBODY_CUDA_UNROLL
+#define NBODY_CUDA_UNROLL 8
+#endif
+constexpr int CUDA_UNROLL = NBODY_CUDA_UNROLL;
+
+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const cudaError_t error, const char* expression,
+                              const char* file, const int line) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d while executing %s: %s\n",
+                 file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression)                                                   \
+    do {                                                                         \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (expression);                        \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                    \
+            cudaFailure(cuda_check_error, #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__);       \
+        }                                                                         \
+    } while (false)
+
+// A warp advances 32 bodies and cooperatively stages 32 source positions at a
+// time. Warp synchronization is sufficient for the one-warp block, minimizing
+// barriers while retaining broadcast-friendly shared-memory reads. Positions
+// are double-buffered so velocity update and integration can safely stay fused.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE)
+void simulationStepKernel(const double4* __restrict__ positions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                          double4* __restrict__ velocities,
+                          const int numBodies) {
+    __shared__ double4 positionTile[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+
+    const int bodyIndex = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+                        + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+
+    double px = 0.0;
+    double py = 0.0;
+    double pz = 0.0;
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        const double4 position = positions[bodyIndex];
+        px = position.x;
+        py = position.y;
+        pz = position.z;
+    }
+
+    double forceX = 0.0;
+    double forceY = 0.0;
+    double forceZ = 0.0;
+
+    for (int tileStart = 0; tileStart < numBodies;
+         tileStart += CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) {
+        const int sourceIndex = tileStart + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (sourceIndex < numBodies) {
+            positionTile[threadIdx.x] = positions[sourceIndex];
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+
+        const int tileSize = min(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, numBodies - tileStart);
+        if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+#pragma unroll CUDA_UNROLL
+            for (int j = 0; j < tileSize; ++j) {
+                const double4 source = positionTile[j];
+                const double dx = source.x - px;
+                const double dy = source.y - py;
+                const double dz = source.z - pz;
+                const double distanceSquared =
+                    dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+#ifdef NBODY_USE_RSQRT
+                const double inverseDistance = rsqrt(distanceSquared);
+#else
+                const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+#endif
+                const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance;
+
+                forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+    }
+
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        double4 velocity = velocities[bodyIndex];
+        velocity.x += DT * forceX;
+        velocity.y += DT * forceY;
+        velocity.z += DT * forceZ;
+        velocities[bodyIndex] = velocity;
+        nextPositions[bodyIndex] = make_double4(
+            px + velocity.x * DT,
+            py + velocity.y * DT,
+            pz + velocity.z * DT,
+            0.0);
+    }
+}

+#ifndef NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+#define NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE 32
+#endif
+constexpr int CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE = NBODY_CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
+#ifndef NBODY_CUDA_UNROLL
+#define NBODY_CUDA_UNROLL 8
+#endif
+constexpr int CUDA_UNROLL = NBODY_CUDA_UNROLL;
+
+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const cudaError_t error, const char* expression,
+                              const char* file, const int line) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d while executing %s: %s\n",
+                 file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression)                                                   \
+    do {                                                                         \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (expression);                        \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                    \
+            cudaFailure(cuda_check_error, #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__);       \
+        }                                                                         \
+    } while (false)
+
+// A warp advances 32 bodies and cooperatively stages 32 source positions at a
+// time. Warp synchronization is sufficient for the one-warp block, minimizing
+// barriers while retaining broadcast-friendly shared-memory reads. Positions
+// are double-buffered so velocity update and integration can safely stay fused.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE)
+void simulationStepKernel(const double3* __restrict__ positions,
+                          double3* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                          double3* __restrict__ velocities,
+                          const int numBodies) {
+    __shared__ double3 positionTile[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+
+    const int bodyIndex = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+                        + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+
+    double px = 0.0;
+    double py = 0.0;
+    double pz = 0.0;
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        const double3 position = positions[bodyIndex];
+        px = position.x;
+        py = position.y;
+        pz = position.z;
+    }
+
+    double forceX = 0.0;
+    double forceY = 0.0;
+    double forceZ = 0.0;
+
+    for (int tileStart = 0; tileStart < numBodies;
+         tileStart += CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) {
+        const int sourceIndex = tileStart + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (sourceIndex < numBodies) {
+            positionTile[threadIdx.x] = positions[sourceIndex];
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+
+        const int tileSize = min(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, numBodies - tileStart);
+        if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+#pragma unroll CUDA_UNROLL
+            for (int j = 0; j < tileSize; ++j) {
+                const double3 source = positionTile[j];
+                const double dx = source.x - px;
+                const double dy = source.y - py;
+                const double dz = source.z - pz;
+                const double distanceSquared =
+                    dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+#ifdef NBODY_USE_RSQRT
+                const double inverseDistance = rsqrt(distanceSquared);
+#else
+                const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+#endif
+                const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance;
+
+                forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+    }
+
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        double3 velocity = velocities[bodyIndex];
+        velocity.x += DT * forceX;
+        velocity.y += DT * forceY;
+        velocity.z += DT * forceZ;
+        velocities[bodyIndex] = velocity;
+        nextPositions[bodyIndex] = make_double3(
+            px + velocity.x * DT,
+            py + velocity.y * DT,
+            pz + velocity.z * DT);
+    }
+}

+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const cudaError_t error, const char* expression,
+                              const char* file, const int line) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d while executing %s: %s\n",
+                 file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression)                                                   \
+    do {                                                                         \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (expression);                        \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                    \

+// A warp advances 32 bodies and cooperatively stages 32 source positions at a
+// time. Warp synchronization is sufficient for the one-warp block, minimizing
+// barriers while retaining broadcast-friendly shared-memory reads. Positions
+// are double-buffered so velocity update and integration can safely stay fused.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE)
+void simulationStepKernel(const double3* __restrict__ positions,
+                          double3* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                          double3* __restrict__ velocities,
+                          const int numBodies) {
+    __shared__ double3 positionTile[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+
+    const int bodyIndex = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE
+                        + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+
+    double px = 0.0;
+    double py = 0.0;
+    double pz = 0.0;
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        const double3 position = positions[bodyIndex];
+        px = position.x;
+        py = position.y;
+        pz = position.z;
+    }
+
+    double forceX = 0.0;
+    double forceY = 0.0;
+    double forceZ = 0.0;
+
+    for (int tileStart = 0; tileStart < numBodies;
+         tileStart += CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) {
+        const int sourceIndex = tileStart + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+        if (sourceIndex < numBodies) {
+            positionTile[threadIdx.x] = positions[sourceIndex];
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+
+        const int tileSize = min(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE, numBodies - tileStart);
+        if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+#pragma unroll CUDA_UNROLL
+            for (int j = 0; j < tileSize; ++j) {
+                const double3 source = positionTile[j];
+                const double dx = source.x - px;
+                const double dy = source.y - py;
+                const double dz = source.z - pz;
+                const double distanceSquared =
+                    dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+#ifdef NBODY_USE_RSQRT
+                const double inverseDistance = rsqrt(distanceSquared);
+#else
+                const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+#endif
+                const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance
+                                                   * inverseDistance;
+
+                forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+    }
+
+    if (bodyIndex < numBodies) {
+        double3 velocity = velocities[bodyIndex];
+        velocity.x += DT * forceX;
+        velocity.y += DT * forceY;
+        velocity.z += DT * forceZ;
+        velocities[bodyIndex] = velocity;
+        nextPositions[bodyIndex] = make_double3(
+            px + velocity.x * DT,
+            py + velocity.y * DT,
+            pz + velocity.z * DT);
+    }
+}
